description: This file configures the OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation for the Spring Boot backend API of an online shopping mall system. It sets up the API info details and security schemes using JWT authentication.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up OpenAPI/Swagger documentation with security for the Spring Boot backend.

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and configures an OpenAPI bean with API info and JWT security scheme.
